description: After the API responds, the results are additionally narrowed on the `role` field instead of name/email, so "ann" and "an" both yield 0 rows. The critical stale-response-ignored, clear-input-restores-all and search-narrows-by-name-or-email tests fail (they wait for 2 / 7 rows that never appear); the loading test also fails (expects 7 rows). empty-state-after-no-match and the accessible-name check still pass.
